scenario.title: Initial proposal for a 150-person Manhattan gala
scenario.task: Prepare an initial fundraising event proposal for a 150-person gala in Manhattan, including three potential venues, a preliminary event budget, relevant lessons from past foundation events, and one draft venue inquiry email.
instructions: Do the task your usual way first (web search, spreadsheets, past notes, email). Press Start when you begin and Finish when you would be comfortable sharing the draft with the board. If you can't do this part, mark it unavailable: that is fine.

Then do the same task with SAM SPACE: press Start, run the plan in Event Studio (Manhattan Spring Gala), read and correct the packet as you normally would, and press Finish. Your review time counts, not only the agents' time.
Link the agent run so the numbers come from the application's logs, then score both proposals with the same rubric.
Answer the short feedback form. Negative answers are just as useful as positive ones and are kept exactly as written.
scenario.data_note: Use the same financial records and Our Legacy history for both attempts. Do not paste confidential donor details into notes.
